context.passage:
To: | rose.matro@mymail.com |
From: | customerservice @sitright.com |
Date: | May 7 |
Subject: | Thank you! |

Dear Ms. Matro,

Thank you for purchasing a Sit Right sofa. It will arrive at your home between 9 A.M.
and 12:00 noon on May 15. We are confident it will bring you many hours of relaxation
and joy. We also hope your experience will support our mission to provide quality
comfort at an affordable price.

As a token of our appreciation, we are delighted to offer you an exclusive 15 percent
discount on your next order of one or more items from our online store. As you may
know, our virtual catalog includes armchairs, loveseats, decorative pillows, area rugs,
and much more. To obtain your discount, simply enter the code MATROIS at checkout.
A gain, thank you for your business.

Sincerely,

Juro Tada
Customer Service Specialist

choices: It comes with a set of decorative pillows.
items.question: What is suggested about the sofa Ms. Matro bought?
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：篇章中可定位到“To obtain your discount, simply enter the code MATRO15 at checkout.”。选择理由：该项是原文事实能够充分支持的结论，其他项包含未被支持的信息。正确答案：D（It is reasonably priced.）。
